text: Replaced the pele/mermaid map with @xyflow/react and dagre layout in packages/ui/src/Graph.tsx, using shadcn-style BaseNode cards from components/flow/base-node.tsx fed by new focusFlow/projectFlow builders in analyzers/src/graph.ts, and added Json.tsx so raw tool results render as folding tables and labelled rows with a JSON source toggle. Map opened with its first box in the top-left corner because the initial viewport was set before React Flow's onInit, so the view is now deferred until init; the branch was merged into main (9560214 and 91ab1ff are pushed), and the same session reworked the pitch deck in code/pitch into picture-first slides with a Silo incoming-call popover that plays public/ringtone.mp3 and a DEMO.md newsletter script.
